Lawnpro Hugo is a lawn-care specialist based in Meyerspark that services properties across Pretoria and Johannesburg. Its core offering is a four-season treatment programme, in which a Lawnpro specialist visits a property at least four times a year to apply a seasonal combination treatment aimed at keeping lawns lush, green and free of pests and weeds throughout the year. New and prospective clients are offered a free 14-point lawn and garden analysis, during which a specialist carefully inspects the lawn before recommending treatment. Additional services include lawn aeration, which perforates the soil with small holes so that oxygen, water and nutrients can reach the grass roots, and lawn dressing and composting to maintain long-term garden health. The business also provides dedicated insect control, targeting pests such as mole crickets, one of the most destructive lawn insects in South Africa, as well as general weed control.

Clients can join Lawnpro's rewards programme for ongoing seasonal care.

Legacy Industrial - Ingco Shop in Shop Pretoria trades under Legacy Industrial Supplies, a family-owned company established in 2014 that supplies industrial and hardware products from its Silverton premises and online. Its diversified product range spans personal protective equipment, welding equipment, hand tools, power tools, abrasives, general hardware, lifting equipment and cutting tools, along with automotive supplies and fasteners. The business sells through an online store alongside its physical premises, and highlights its relationships with established tool and hardware brands, offering customers technical support on the products it stocks. Beyond retail sales, Legacy Industrial Supplies also offers repairs and services, and runs in-store specials on selected stock.

Being based in the Silverton industrial area gives the business convenient reach to Pretoria's wider industrial and trade customer base, who can get in touch directly if they cannot find a specific tool or product listed on its website.

Lenaka Business Solutions is a business consultancy based in Atteridgeville that describes its mission as enabling business transformation through innovative, tailored solutions that foster growth, enhance compliance and drive digital transformation. Its core offering is business administration and compliance support, including comprehensive administrative support, record-keeping, business registrations and regulatory compliance management, allowing clients to focus on scaling their operations.

The company also runs a learning and development arm, providing customised training programmes, mentorship initiatives and capacity-building workshops designed to strengthen professional growth and business performance. Alongside this, Lenaka offers coaching and mentorship services, including one-on-one coaching and group mentoring aimed at building skills, confidence and strategic thinking in both individuals and businesses. Its website also lists additional service areas including IT solutions, a virtual hub, e-learning and green projects, reflecting an ambition to support clients across the administrative, technological and environmental aspects of running a business.

Lenga Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a 100% black-owned South African ICT consulting company based at 52 The Grove Street in Parktown Estate. The company positions itself around pairing innovative technology solutions with sustainable business growth, helping organisations integrate technology with strategy to achieve lasting results. Its specialisations include IT infrastructure, business process re-engineering, change management and data analytics, with the stated goal of driving business efficiency and growth for its clients.

Lenga Solutions operates on standard weekday business hours, from 8am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, and is closed over weekends. Being based in Parktown Estate places the company within reach of Pretoria's wider business community, where it supports organisations seeking to modernise their technology use while improving operational processes and decision-making through better use of data.

Livex Software is a software development company headquartered in Pretoria, with its base in Equestria. The company positions itself as one of the leading software development businesses in South Africa, specialising in custom software development, mobile app development and online business solutions aimed at increasing client productivity. Its web development team translates client business ideas into web applications intended to optimise operations, while its mobile offering takes a business's services onto smartphones through a tailored app.

Livex also provides network management and cybersecurity services as part of its broader technology offering, aiming to deliver complete, end-to-end software solutions rather than one-off projects. The company frames its work around helping clients build their brand and grow their business, drawing on experience across multiple aspects of software development, from initial planning through agile development practices to ongoing support once a system is in production.

Lorbrand (Pty) Ltd is a Sunderland Ridge-based manufacturer that designs and produces heavy-duty conveyor belt components, including conveyor idlers, pulleys, frames and impact beds. Each idler and pulley is designed and manufactured in-house at the company's own facilities, using techniques such as centrifugal self-cleaning seals and Finite Element Analysis to create customisable, cost-effective solutions. Its pulley range includes conventional pulleys, slated pulleys, internal bearing pulleys and apron feeder shaft assemblies, along with shrink-fit shafts for specialised applications.

Lorbrand's conveyor idlers are built to be low-friction and energy-efficient, reducing long-term replacement costs by helping components reach their intended design life, while its idler frames are jig- and full-seal-welded to reduce stress, improve belt tracking and prevent premature corrosion. The company offers multiple frame types, including carry in-line, carry offset, underslung carry, adjustable carry, self-aligning, V-return, flat return, retractable carry and impact frames, allowing it to tailor conveyor solutions to different project requirements.

LS Windings is an electric motor repair and rewinding specialist operating from a workshop base in Annlin, Pretoria, serving municipal, mining and industrial clients around the clock. The business positions itself around minimising downtime through precision AC and DC motor repair, offering complete motor diagnostics, dynamic balancing and precision rewinding using high-grade insulation systems designed to resist thermal breakdown. Its workshop is equipped with burnout ovens and testing rigs, allowing technicians to diagnose and resolve critical system failures on-site. Beyond motor rewinding, LS Windings carries out industrial pump work, including comprehensive overhauls, seal replacement and performance testing for both water-supply pumps and heavy-duty slurry pumps used in mining and industrial settings. The company also services generators and alternators, including emergency rewinding work, supporting clients who depend on backup power during municipal or industrial outages.

Being based in Annlin gives the business convenient reach across Pretoria's industrial corridor.

LTA Accountants is an accounting firm based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park that aims to provide a complete accounting solution for both individuals and companies. Its services range from company registrations and monthly bookkeeping through to compiling annual financial statements and filing tax returns, giving clients a single point of contact for their accounting, payroll, tax and administrative needs. The firm focuses particularly on small and medium-sized businesses, offering tailored packages designed to match each client's size and industry rather than a one-size-fits-all service.

LTA Accountants describes its approach as building lasting networks of accounting support, emphasising getting to know clients personally so that the service provided suits their specific circumstances. Being based in the Pierre van Ryneveld Park and Centurion area positions the firm to serve both individual taxpayers and growing local businesses that need ongoing, relationship-based accounting support.

Lucky Bread Company operates a bakery and store at The Village in Hazelwood, located at 20 16th Street, Pretoria. The Hazelwood branch was announced in mid-2025, with the company describing the opening as bringing its signature flavour and flair to The Village, and the store was set to open on 12 November 2025. The Hazelwood store trades daily, with longer hours on Friday and Saturday evenings and a shorter Sunday trading day, in line with the rest of the Lucky Bread Company group.

The business also introduced a dedicated catering menu in October 2025, offering handcrafted food and baked goods for a range of occasions beyond its regular in-store offering. The Hazelwood branch forms part of a wider Lucky Bread Company network across Pretoria and the surrounding region, which includes stores at locations such as Brooklyn Mall, Menlyn Maine, Castle Gate Lifestyle Centre and the University of Pretoria's Hatfield campus, alongside its production facility in Centurion.

M C R Manufacturing Co (Pty) Ltd is a precision engineering business based in Rosslyn that specialises in the machining, coating and assembly of medium to high-volume components for the automotive, rail and general engineering industries. The company operates a CNC machining facility and supplies precision-machined, safety-critical components manufactured to IATF 16949 quality standards, working with materials such as steel, cast steel, cast iron, ductile iron, aluminium and other exotic materials, in the form of castings, forgings and solid stock.

On the automotive side, MCR supplies cast and machined components, including safety-critical parts, for passenger, light commercial and commercial vehicles, while its railway division supplies components for the rail industry. The business describes a strict internal quality process, in which every component passes a first-off inspection in its own laboratory before undergoing constant sampling checks throughout the production run, reflecting its stated aim of supplying zero-defect components at competitive prices to its customers.

Macpro Panelbeaters is a panel beating and spray-painting business that has traded in Pretoria's panel and paint industry from its base in Koedoespoort Industrial. The company is a member of SAMBRA, recognised as an advanced structural repairer, as well as the Retail Motor Industry Organisation, and holds a Level 4 BBBEE rating. It offers a free on-site quotation service and uses trained, qualified staff to handle vehicle body repairs ranging from small dents to major structural damage.

Macpro serves fleet owners, motor institutions, major insurance companies and vehicle manufacturers as well as members of the public, and carries its own internal and external risk cover for added client peace of mind. To monitor its own service standards, the business runs a weekly customer satisfaction survey conducted via SMS, which it uses to continually refine the quality of its repair and workmanship.

Its polymers are used across a range of industries, including the paint industry, mining industry, textile printing industry, construction industry and industrial painting, reflecting a broad base of customers who rely on emulsion-based products for their own manufacturing processes. Makeean Polymers states that its ongoing aim is to exceed market expectations by focusing on product quality, customer service and continuous improvement, supplying emulsion polymers from its Samcor Park base to industrial customers across South Africa and abroad.

MGB Konstruksie is a home-building company serving Pretoria East and Centurion from its base in Constantia Park, offering a full building service from initial concept through to completion. The company provides new home construction as well as renovations and additions, and offers prospective clients a free cost analysis based on their own building plans before work begins.

MGB Konstruksie describes its vision as building houses that stand as monuments long after completion, and structures its service around guiding clients through each stage of the building process, from initial planning and design through to the final finishes. The company presents itself as a reliable, professional alternative in a construction industry it acknowledges can be difficult to navigate, aiming to build trust with clients through consistent communication and workmanship across each project it undertakes.

Minuteman Press Centurion operates from Simarlo Park in Hennopspark, offering printing, design and branding services to the Centurion community while also couriering products nationwide. The business describes itself as a leading local supplier of printing and branding services, with its top-selling products including business cards, postcards, brochures, flyers, forms and promotional pens and posters. Alongside standard print runs, Minuteman Press Centurion offers graphic design services, custom apparel and branded clothing, and large custom banners for businesses wanting to raise their visibility.

Customers can work from a pre-made design, collaborate directly with the in-house design team, or upload a completed, ready-to-print file, and existing customers can place repeat orders for previous projects. The store trades Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm, Friday from 8am to 4pm and Saturday mornings from 8am to midday, and is closed on Sundays, public holidays and long weekends.

MiRO Distribution is an IT and ICT distributor operating across South Africa and the wider SADC region, specialising in IP convergence solutions for internet service providers, technology resellers and installers. From its Samrand Business Park base in Kosmosdal, the company distributes products across categories including Wi-Fi equipment, broadband and carrier wireless gear, antennas and masts, networking hardware, cabling and cabinets, and surge and power tools.

Customers ordering through MiRO can arrange shipping or collect selected items directly from the company's branches, which include its Centurion location alongside branches in Cape Town, Durban and Nelspruit. The company also runs a business partner programme aimed at bringing internet service providers, resellers and installers into its distribution network, and periodically hosts manufacturer-led training sessions, such as courses covering Ubiquiti and MikroTik equipment, for partners wanting to build their technical expertise on the brands MiRO distributes.

MKO Engineers is an engineering consultancy based in Heuwelsig Estate, Centurion, made up of certificated engineers who describe their work as providing engineering solutions for sustainable development. The company focuses on improving health and safety outcomes in mines and factories, drawing on scientific, mathematical and engineering knowledge to address practical problems on client sites. Beyond technical engineering input, MKO Engineers positions itself as bringing leadership, management and a technological approach to industry challenges, combined with commercial, statutory, safety and environmental knowledge, helping clients navigate the regulatory and operational demands of plant engineering work. The company also offers an emergency response service for urgent engineering issues. MKO Engineers holds a Level 1 BBBEE contributor rating, a status it highlights to corporate and industrial clients.

Operating from Centurion gives the practice convenient access to the mining, manufacturing, water treatment and energy sector clients it serves across the wider Gauteng region.

Montana Centre is a business centre in Sinoville, Pretoria, offering coworking spaces, meeting rooms and general business services in a shared working environment. The centre is positioned as a practical option for startups and small teams that need flexible workspace without committing to a traditional office lease, combining professional facilities with a community-focused setting.

On-site food and drink options are available to tenants and visitors, adding convenience alongside the centre's access to nearby shops and other amenities in Sinoville. The building includes a wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking, making it accessible to a broader range of visitors and tenants. Montana Centre's central Sinoville location gives businesses based there convenient reach across northern Pretoria, while still offering the practical infrastructure, such as bookable meeting rooms, that small teams and growing companies typically need day to day.

National Tools & Safety is a workshop supplies retailer based in Donkerhoek that stocks tools, safety equipment and related hardware for trade and DIY customers. Its range covers hand and power tool accessories, abrasives and grinding and polishing supplies such as backing pads, belts, fibre discs and flap discs, along with drill bits, pneumatics and general fasteners including bolts, nuts, washers and rivets. The business also supplies rigging and lifting equipment, including beam clamps, trolleys, hoists, slings and spring balancers, as well as workshop storage solutions such as ladders, storage bins and wheelie bins.

Specialist measuring equipment forms part of the range too, including laser distance meters and steel-bladed measuring tapes with co-moulded rubber casings. By combining everyday consumables with more specialised rigging, measuring and abrasive products, National Tools & Safety serves both routine workshop restocking needs and specialised trade and industrial requirements from its Donkerhoek premises.

Nellwood Frames And Laser Cutting is a framing studio based in Rietfontein that combines custom picture framing with laser cutting and related finishing services. Its core offering includes custom frames, graduation frames and box frames, built to order for individual customers rather than sold as standard stock sizes. Alongside framing, the business operates laser cutting equipment used for branding and custom projects, and also offers printing, engraving and embroidery services to clients looking to personalise items beyond framed artwork or certificates.

Customers can request a free quote before committing to a project, and the business has built a reputation locally for efficient turnaround and quality finishing on framing and laser-cut work. By combining traditional custom framing with laser-based branding and engraving under one roof, Nellwood Frames And Laser Cutting handles projects ranging from framing a graduation certificate to producing branded or engraved items for events and gifting.

NHBRC Registration is a facilitation service based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, that helps builders and construction companies obtain registration with the National Home Builders Registration Council. The business offers an online registration service, priced from R3,290, aimed at getting construction companies registered with the NHBRC in the shortest possible timeframe, and provides a free initial consultation to new enquiries. Its team includes accountants registered with SAIBA, CIMA and SAIT, including an accredited SARS tax practitioner, who assist with wider compliance requirements that often accompany NHBRC registration, such as CIPC company registration, SARS tax registration verification, and PAYE, UIF and SDL registration for businesses with employees.

The company explains that any developer or contractor building residential dwellings is legally required to register with the NHBRC, and that separate CIDB registration is needed to apply for construction contracts and government tenders. Clients are assigned a dedicated consultant to guide them through the process, and the business also offers a broader construction compliance package.

OK Supermarket Erasmia is a full-service supermarket located at Erasmia Crossing on Main Road in Erasmia, combining a general grocery offering with an in-house butchery, bakery and takeaway counter. Ordiphase (Pty) Ltd is a Waverley-based energy services company that grew out of seven years of research and development, between 2014 and 2021, into sustainable alternative energy solutions, carried out in partnership with Eco-V (Pty) Ltd under the GreenTower brand. The company operates as an Energy Service Company, providing GreenTower ESS solar energy security solutions to clients across Africa, and combines its solar hardware with online management platforms that take an Internet of Things approach to managing electricity loads and improving solar generation performance.

Ordiphase's solutions are aimed at residential clients, security complexes, small businesses and light industrial customers seeking dependable, cost-effective access to solar energy. The company has been recognised for its work in the clean energy space over several years, including being named a registered PV Green Card installer in 2014, taking part in the Swedish Smart Living Challenge the same year, and later being honoured at South Africa's GreenOvation Awards in 2016 as a leading change-maker and energy efficiency champion, among other local and international innovation accolades received between 2015 and 2022.

Ornecy (Pty) Ltd is a Centurion-based company, with premises in Amberfield Manor, that provides integrated human resources, payroll and custom software solutions under the banner of being a client's single source of truth. Its platform is designed to bring HR, payroll and bespoke applications together in one connected system that can be securely accessed around the clock from anywhere. On the payroll side, Ornecy offers payroll outsourcing services, while its human resources offering covers end-to-end employee life-cycle management, from onboarding through to offboarding.

The company also undertakes software development work, building flexible custom applications to meet varied client requirements, and provides consulting services aimed at giving clients a compliance, operational and strategic advantage through technical advice. Within its platform, Ornecy's product set extends to organisational management tools with dynamic reporting charts, health and safety modules, talent management, day-to-day HR operations, employee relations tools, compensation and benefits management, time and attendance tracking, and a learning academy for staff training.

Osman's Optical Hazeldean Square Oogkundige is an optometry practice located within Hazeldean Square in Pretoria East, part of the wider Osman's Optical group that has served South African patients with eye care for decades. The practice combines professional eye testing with personalised care and a selection of eyewear and contact lenses, using on-site diagnostic equipment and offering walk-in convenience along with on-site spectacle repairs. Its core service is a comprehensive basic eye exam designed to assess precise vision and overall eye health, alongside contact lens fittings that take a patient's eyes, lifestyle and vision needs into account to find a suitable lens.

The practice also offers glaucoma screening, using early eye-pressure checks to catch the condition before vision loss occurs, as well as dedicated children's eye screening and school vision screening aimed at identifying problems that could affect a child's learning. For corporate clients, Osman's Optical provides on-site or in-practice corporate eye screening to support employee eye health and productivity, and the practice accepts medical aid.

Pachas Restaurant is an upmarket steakhouse and seafood restaurant in Pretoria, with its menu built around premium steaks, fresh seafood and poultry alongside South African dishes. Established in 1985, the restaurant has remained part of Pretoria's fine dining scene for more than four decades, with its founding partners continuing to guide the business today. Alongside its main dining room, Pachas offers private function rooms suitable for business meals and other functions, and the establishment is wheelchair-friendly, making it accessible to a wider range of diners.

The restaurant has been recognised locally through reader polls as a favourite for both fine dining and romantic dining occasions in Pretoria, reflecting its long-standing reputation in the city. Pachas frames its longevity as a legacy built on consistent culinary standards and hospitality rather than frequent reinvention, positioning the restaurant as a long-established option for guests seeking a traditional upmarket dining experience.

Pharmafen (Pty) Ltd is a South African pharmaceutical and wellness company founded in 2020 and based in Pretoria, operating as a pharmacy group across several of its own product brands.
